description: Rhomboid major stretches from the thoracic spine to the scapula's medial edge, creating the planar fold that tethers the shoulder blade to the rib cage.
actions: Retracts the scapula, drawing it toward the spine to square the shoulders in upright poses.
Downwardly rotates the scapula, letting the glenoid face slightly lower for weight-bearing gestures.
Pins the scapula against the rib cage, smoothing the costal surface when the arm braces against resistance.
